paper_identity.working_title: When does landscape configuration add held-out information? An auditable reference-conditioned framework across islands and forest fragments

core_question: After a declared reference model has already represented local support, source proximity and generic landscape context, does occurrence-conditioned landscape configuration retain additional held-out information?
central_claim: Structural information is reference-conditioned: an occurrence-conditioned landscape signal can be detectable under a restricted reference yet fail to provide incremental held-out predictive value beyond a richer reference. Therefore structural adequacy must be earned relative to an explicitly declared reference and endpoint.

aislands_original.estimand: conditional ordering beyond climatic support and nearest outer-training source distance

aislands_strong_reference.estimand: paired held-out log-loss increment of species-conditioned EOG connected frequency beyond frozen R3

tanzania.estimand: paired held-out log-loss increment beyond patch area, training-selected matrix-aware current flow and nearest training source

reference_conditioning_rule.restricted_reference_result_may_support: conditional structural ordering at that declared reference depth
reference_conditioning_rule.strong_reference_result_required_for: incremental predictive-value claims beyond a richer reference

eog_wf_endpoints_not_empirical_evidence_: Southwest Louisiana King Rail passive acoustics

allowed_claims: Occurrence-conditioned landscape configuration retained conditional incidence-ordering information beyond climatic support and nearest-source distance in the original A-Islands benchmark.
The original A-Islands signal did not earn a general incremental predictive claim beyond the prospectively frozen richer R3 reference.
Tanzania independently showed that the same class of structural addition was not universally additive beyond a matrix-aware strong reference.
Structural information must be interpreted relative to an explicitly declared reference and endpoint.
EOG connected frequency is a structural robustness summary over declared graph scenarios, not a colonisation or dispersal probability.
prohibited_claims: EOG universally outperforms SDMs or connectivity models
connected frequency estimates realised movement, dispersal or colonisation probability
the paper discovers that island isolation is multidimensional
the paper discovers stepping stones or graph connectivity
R3 causally explains the original A-Islands conditional-concordance signal
R3 universally outperforms simpler island-isolation references
Tanzania establishes universal superiority of current flow
cross-system differences identify a causal mechanism
A-Islands conditional concordance and strong-reference log-loss increment are one common effect size
EOG-WF Layer A or Layer B endpoint results are additional empirical replications of this paper
